allowed: Existing v3 cal/eval score and observation caches only; no protected 480/test, fitting, model/readout/cal-threshold changes
curve: All finite eval score ties plus disabled +inf; -inf remains unavailable. For each exactly reachable FREE count maximize W, then maximize threshold. No interpolation or randomized tie splitting.
selection: Floor percentage times local FREE denominator; choose greatest reachable FREE count <= cap, then its maximum W. FREE denominator zero => N/E for rates and matched-rate comparison; exact count curve remains descriptive.

bootstrap.clusters: all original 12 eval visits, including zero-row FARO visits
bootstrap.reselection: Recompute weighted whole-tie W/F in each paired visit draw and reselect nearest reachable point below floor(rate * resampled FREE denominator)
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile descriptive interval for W difference and POS-normalized pp; omit zero-FREE/POS draws, disclose count

per_visit: Individually select same-rate oracle point using each visit's FREE denominator; also show visit contributions under full-eval pooled oracle thresholds. Use individual visit selection for rule (b); zero FREE => N/E, does not count as success.
loss: All 126 native middle-band POS queries RGB_pred & !D_prime_pred at original sealed working points. RGB margin quartiles among all RGB-supported POS; cached RGB depth support rays and median observed axial Z within band; ToF UNKNOWN/support and raw accepted-peak SNR; finite outside-query evidence described separately from UNKNOWN and physical emptiness.

decision.a: native middle at 1%,2%,5%: D_prime W >= rgb W AND >= or W at every level
decision.b: native middle at each of 2%,5%: >=8/12 visits D_prime W >= rgb W using per-visit same-rate selection
decision.if_both: 建议进入条件仲裁器设计与新 visit 确认
decision.otherwise: D′ 的双向占优不稳定，暂停融合迭代

boundary: Eval-label thresholds are posthoc oracles for ranking only, never deployable working points. Original preregistered v3 FAIL text/numbers unchanged; add only one linked explanatory sentence to CURRENT_DECISION.
deliverables: all ties and exact-F curves CSV/plot
decision_check: Primary native middle has POS2077/FREE689, 1/2/5 percent caps are 6/13/34. Equality meets descriptive rule, not inferential noninferiority; 12 visits permit threshold 8. This is a successor-design decision only, not confirmation or baseline promotion.
